## Sanity Checks

This case is used for automated verification only (verifier smoke tests).
No manual listening observations required.

- [ ] Phone boundary ranges within segment bounds
- [ ] Phone identity cross-checked with TIMIT gold labels
- [ ] Confidence values in [0,1]
- [ ] No phone timeline items with start_ms >= end_ms
